about.title: One line of responsibility
about.text: Since 2020 we have built websites and software systems for private business and the public sector. We cover the cycle from interface and architecture through engineering, integrations and support. We work formally as sole proprietor Kutman Syradzhinovich Zairov — with a contract and ownership of the outcome.

points.title: Contract
points.text: A registered practice, stated stages and a clear handoff.

points.title: Two sectors
points.text: Private business and public-sector work — since 2020.

points.title: Full cycle
points.text: Design, engineering, launch and later changes stay in one place.

points.title: After launch
points.text: Access is handed over. Support stays if the system needs to grow.

privacy.heading: Who
privacy.body: Sole proprietor Kutman Syradzhinovich Zairov, ZAIROV, Kyrgyzstan.

privacy.heading: What the form sends
privacy.body: Name, sector, interest, phone or Telegram, the task, and the page language. Only what you type yourself.

privacy.heading: Why
privacy.body: To reply to the request. The message arrives in the studio Telegram. The site does not keep a separate request database.

privacy.heading: What we do not do
privacy.body: There is no account, no advertising trackers, and these details are not passed on for advertising.
